name: Sugar Daddy Old Man
source:
A sugar daddy old man who is a regular customer of [url=/c95194]Kuzuhara[/url]'s group. He loves school girls and frequents them quite often. Kuzuhara has taken a liking to him as well since he pays generously, and through her he has gotten in touch with several school girls who he has a relationship with.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
